design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (round 5).
DRAW (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[6,6,6,6].
WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller only wants to pay her condo renewal. Her lender's refinance closing of 2026-09-25 left three rated requests unbilled: the building limit to 190000, then the contents limit to 50000, then both deductibles to 1250, each rated by the engine on top of the one before. The contents request is only identifiable once the building limit is on the policy, and each later request's rise is measured from the request it was rated on; the first request's rise is measured from the premium booked at the term start, because the certificate applied on 2026-10-01 changed the rating basis after the request was rated. All three take effect on the closing date because the premium arrived before it. The renewal keeps the deductible decrease's rise outside the annual cap, rates the coming term as her primary residence on the designation she certified, credits the current term's surcharge gap from the date she moved in (the sale of her former home insured under HomeFlood, more than half the term remaining), and sets the unrefunded re-rate credit against the remittance.
SCOPE: task 0 claims dwelling_ext_coverage_increase_charge, dwelling_ext_contents_increase_charge, dwelling_ext_deductible_decrease_charge, dwelling_ext_renewal_remittance and their four tools; task 1 claims the other three.
PROBLEM TREE: root renewal <- deductible decrease (value_input, outside_rise) <- contents increase (value_input, prior_figure) <- building increase (value_input, prior_figure). Gold order: building 8, contents 10, deductible 12, payment 14.
FACTORS: coverage_increase_charge ['building_anchor', 'building_wait', 'building_premium_window', 'building_transaction_window', 'building_quote_window', 'building_rise']; contents_increase_charge ['contents_anchor', 'contents_wait', 'contents_premium_window', 'contents_transaction_window', 'contents_quote_window', 'contents_rise']; deductible_decrease_charge ['deductible_anchor', 'deductible_wait', 'deductible_premium_window', 'deductible_transaction_window', 'deductible_quote_window', 'deductible_rise']; renewal_remittance ['outside_rise_rule', 'residence_credit_rule', 'setoff_rule', 'bill_window_rule', 'term_end_window_rule', 'remittance_claim_window_rule'].
GOLD: building risk_premium_charge 14.6 (rfa 2.63, endorsed 1165.37); contents 2.43 (rfa 0.44, endorsed 1189.37); deductible 3.65 (rfa 0.66, endorsed 1225.37); all effective 2026-09-25; amount 1524.52 by CREDIT_CARD. Baselines 9.61, 6.98, 7.25, 1778.21.
NEAR-MISSES: each rise measured from the rated figure on the policy; the contents and deductible rises measured from the booked premium instead of the request they were rated on; the 30-day wait from the receipt date; no residence credit, or a credit from the designation alone; paying the coming term's premium without the set-off.
user_scenario: You are Celeste Arceneaux, a retired school librarian in New Orleans who likes to get her bills settled early and talks in a warm, slightly chatty way. You are calling Tidemark because the renewal bill for the federal flood policy on your condominium came in the mail and you want to pay the renewal now, by credit card, so the policy does not run out on November 1. You want it paid today and you are happy to make the payment yourself on this call. You do not have the bill in front of you and do not remember the amount on it; you expect the representative to tell you what to pay. If you are asked who you are, your name is Celeste Arceneaux and the phone number on your account is 5045510417. Only if you are asked for something more to confirm it is you, the ZIP code of your mailing address is 70124; if you are asked for yet another detail, the last four digits of your Social Security number are 1482. Only if you are asked for the policy number, it is 1104582261, and the condo is 168 Robert E Lee Blvd Unit 1C. Whenever the representative tells you that something on the policy has to be put through or corrected before the renewal amount can be settled, you tell them to go ahead and take care of it for you, and you wait. You do not ask for anything else to be done and you do not bring up anything else about the policy. When the representative gives you the payment step to complete yourself, you pay exactly the amount the representative tells you, by credit card, for this condo policy, entering any credit figure the representative tells you to enter exactly as given. If the amount sounds high to you, you only say it is more than you hoped and still pay it. Once the payment goes through and you have heard it is received, you thank the representative and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The contents increase is selected only once the policy carries the building limit the building increase sets, and is rated on top of it; the deductible decrease is rated on top of the contents increase, recorded last among the closing's increases; the renewal keeps the decrease's rise outside the cap only once it has taken effect. Each step therefore needs the one before it, so the order is fixed.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the building increase billed, no pending coverage-increase request carries the building limit on the policy, so there is no contents increase to bill.
Without the contents increase billed, the deductible decrease falls to the re-rate tier and is charged 20.68 instead of 3.65.
Without the deductible decrease billed the remittance is 1477.73 instead of 1524.52.
